title: Air Jordan 6 Retro 'White Infrared' (White/Light Crimson-Black, CT8529-105): first retail release since 2014; ₹18,395 MRP at Superkicks (UK 7-12 in stock, UK 6 sold out, checked 04:50 IST 12 Nov 2026) and VegNonVeg (UK 7-11 listed, checked 04:52 IST); global release 7 Nov 2026 at US$215 on SNKRS and select Jordan retailers (Sole Retriever, Complex, Nike); Nike calls the Jordan 6 Michael Jordan's 'championship game shoe' and 'White Infrared' one of its 1991 launch colourways; the embroidered Nike Air heel logo returns (2010 and 2014 retros had a Jumpman); 2014 pairs carry style code 384664-123
